issue: The `end` variable is calculated using the same formula as `start` (both use `slotStartTime.hour()` and `slotStartTime.minute()`). This should calculate the slot end time using slotEndTime instead, causing incorrect validation of working hours as the end time check will always be identical to the start time check.
Comparing dayjs objects using the `===` operator will always return false because it compares object references, not the actual date/time values. Should use `.isSame()` method instead.
Missing space after '//' in comment for 'check if date override for slot exists'
Missing space after '//' in comment for 'if no date override for slot exists check if it is within normal work hours'

The call to `checkIfIsAvailable` is missing the `dateOverrides` and `workingHours` parameters. Unlike other calls which spread the user schedule object containing these fields, this call only spreads `availabilityCheckProps` which only contains `eventLength` and `currentSeats`, potentially allowing bookings at times when the user is unavailable.

No test was added to verify that date overrides are properly applied to fixed hosts in round-robin scheduling scenarios, leaving the main bug fix untested despite the PR description stating this should be covered.
